passages.title: Employee health fair · Document 1
passages.text: The annual employee health fair takes place on August 12. Several local clinics {{1}} free basic screenings in the main auditorium. To help us plan staffing, register {{2}} Friday. {{3}} advance registration is encouraged, walk-in visitors may use any appointments left open. {{4}}

passages.title: Studio kiln booking · Document 1
passages.text:
NOTICE

Pottery groups must reserve kiln time {{1}} advance. Pieces should be completely dry before they are {{2}} to the technician. {{3}}, work containing unidentified glazes cannot be accepted, even with a booking. Label every tray with the group name and firing temperature. {{4}}

passages.title: Remote interview preparation · Document 1
passages.text:
To applicants,

Please test your microphone {{1}} the interview begins. A private link will be sent to the address {{2}} on your application. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder. Contact recruitment if it is still missing; {{3}}, you might request an unnecessary replacement appointment. We will not ask for payment to release an interview link. {{4}}

passages.title: Question Ocean · P6-G36 · Document 1
passages.text:
To: Project Coordinators
From: Digital Workplace Team
Subject: Meeting-Notes Pilot

Next month, twelve project teams will test a tool that creates draft meeting notes. The pilot is intended to {{1}} whether the tool can reduce routine administrative work without omitting important decisions. Team leaders must review every draft {{2}} it is shared with participants. {{3}} For that reason, confidential client names should not be entered during the trial. At the end of each week, participants will complete a short survey and provide {{4}} on any corrections they made.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R14 · Document 1
passages.text:
Community Technology Day

The Westfield Community Center will offer free thirty-minute consultations on Saturday, August 9. Volunteers will help residents set up e-mail accounts, install security updates, and organize digital photographs. Appointments are recommended, but walk-in visitors will be assisted if time permits. Participants should bring their own devices and charging cables.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R31 · Document 1
passages.text:
To: All Branch Managers
From: Customer Relations
Subject: Updated Complaint Form

An updated customer complaint form is now available on the company intranet. Beginning Monday, please use the new form for all service-related complaints. The form includes an additional section for recording follow-up actions. Existing paper copies should be recycled by the end of this week.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R25 · Document 1
passages.text:
Shipping Update — Order 90417

Your order left our distribution center on Tuesday and is expected to arrive on Friday. A signature will be required at delivery because the package contains electronic equipment valued at more than $500. To authorize delivery to a neighbor or change the delivery date, visit the carrier's website before 8 P.M. on Thursday.

passages.title: Archive image requests · Document 1
passages.text:
DIGITAL COPY SERVICE
Researchers may request scans of cataloged archive items. The service fee covers staff time and file delivery, not permission to publish material whose rights belong to another party. A scan supplied for private research may therefore need further clearance before appearing in a book or website. Fragile items can be excluded from scanning if handling would risk damage. We will explain any restriction before processing payment.

passages.title: Hotel meeting refreshment order · Document 1
passages.text:
To: Event organizers
Refreshment numbers must be confirmed two working days before your meeting. We can reduce the order before that deadline, but late reductions do not lower the guaranteed catering charge. Additional portions may be possible if stock permits and will be billed separately. Meeting-room capacity and refreshment numbers are separate; ordering more coffee does not authorize extra attendees beyond the room's approved limit.

passages.title: Limited exhibition extension · Document 1
passages.text:
VISITOR UPDATE
The photography exhibition has been extended until Sunday, but guided evening tours still end on Friday as originally advertised. Standard daytime admission continues through the extension, and existing unused daytime tickets remain valid. A ticket for a specific evening tour cannot be used for an unscheduled tour on Saturday. Contact the booking desk if you cannot attend your reserved evening; staff can explain the applicable exchange options.

passages.title: Exhibition panel return · Document 1
passages.text:
RETURN INSTRUCTIONS
The reusable exhibition panels must be returned in their numbered sleeves. Small scuff marks from normal use are included in the hire fee; holes or adhesive residue may incur repair charges. Photograph any existing damage before packing. The courier appointment covers collection from the loading bay only. If you need the panels carried from an upper floor, tell us before the collection date so that additional handling can be arranged.

passages.title: Community repair queue · Document 1
passages.text:
REPAIR CAFE
We assess items in arrival order, but an assessment is not a promise that a repair can be completed that day. Some work needs specialist parts or skills. If we cannot proceed safely, we will explain the limitation and may suggest another service. Please bring accessories needed to demonstrate the fault. Volunteers do not charge for their time, although replacement parts may have a cost that must be agreed before fitting.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R72 · Document 1
passages.text:
Device Return Procedure

Before returning a company laptop, employees should upload active project files to the secure transfer folder. Next, they must submit the online return form; the system then creates a tracking label. The laptop and its power adapter should be placed in the reusable shipping sleeve, but external keyboards should remain at the employee's office. After the courier scans the label, the employee receives an automatic receipt. IT will close the equipment record only after confirming that the device starts normally and that no accessories are missing.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R56 · Document 1
passages.text:
Website Notice: Community Tool Library

The Eastview Community Center now allows residents to borrow small home-repair tools for up to seven days. Items include drills, measuring kits, paint rollers, and basic gardening tools. Residents must present proof of address and complete a short safety agreement before borrowing any item.

Tools may be renewed once if no one else has requested them. Late returns will result in a temporary borrowing suspension rather than a fee. The center chose this policy because staff members wanted the service to remain affordable while still encouraging timely returns. Donations of clean, working tools are accepted on the first Saturday of each month.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R68 · Document 1
passages.text:
Internal Post

The office cafeteria will test a pre-order lunch system from August 5 to August 16. Employees may order meals through the company app before 10 A.M. and pick them up between noon and 1 P.M. The test is intended to reduce lines during the busiest lunch period.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R68 · Document 2
passages.text:
Survey Result

In last month's facilities survey, 62 percent of employees said cafeteria lines were too long on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Only 18 percent said menu variety was the main issue.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R68 · Document 3
passages.text:
Manager Message

Please encourage your teams to use the pre-order feature, especially on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We need enough participation to decide whether to continue the system after the trial. Employees who forget to pre-order may still buy lunch in person, but regular lines may remain long.

The shipment notice lists one Stand E, but I approved six Stand S units for the new branch. All six displays must match before installation on Monday. Please replace the substituted item and confirm whether the correct stand can arrive in time.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R48 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Naomi Clark, Workplace Services
To: All Employees
Subject: Desk-Booking Pilot

From September 9 to October 4, employees on the third floor will test a desk-booking feature in the company app. The feature allows staff members to reserve a workstation up to five days in advance. Employees who need dual monitors should choose desks marked with a blue icon. Please submit comments through the feedback form by October 7.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R48 · Document 2
passages.text:
FAQ EXCERPT
Q: Can I reserve a desk for a visitor?
A: No. Visitor workstations must still be requested through Reception because guest access badges are issued separately.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R48 · Document 3

CHAT MESSAGE

passages.title: Shared workspace access · Document 1
passages.text:
FLEX WORKSPACE
Day passes provide access from 8 A.M. to 6 P.M. Evening access requires an active monthly plan. Meeting rooms are booked separately; a desk reservation does not include a room. Monthly members may bring one registered guest, who must remain with the host.

passages.title: Shared workspace access · Document 2
passages.text:
From: Alba Ruiz
I have a day pass for Tuesday and a desk booked until six. My client can only meet at six thirty. Could I keep the desk later and bring him as a guest, or do I need a different arrangement? We need a quiet place for a forty-minute call.

passages.title: Shared workspace access · Document 3
passages.text:
To: Alba Ruiz
Your day pass does not cover the proposed time or monthly-member guest benefit. We can offer an independently booked meeting room from 6:15 to 7:15 P.M.; both attendees will be registered for that room only. The fee is$35. This does not extend general desk access. Please confirm before noon Monday if you want us to hold it.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R70 · Document 1
passages.text:
Newsletter

The Riverfront Business District will sponsor a Saturday clean-up event on September 14. Volunteers will remove litter from sidewalks, plant flowers near storefronts, and report damaged street signs. Businesses that send at least three volunteers will be listed on the district website.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R70 · Document 2
passages.text:
Volunteer Sign-up Note

Tools and gloves will be provided, but volunteers should bring refillable water bottles. Check-in begins at 8:30 A.M. behind the public library. The planting team will leave first because flowers must be placed before temperatures rise.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R70 · Document 3
passages.text:
E-mail

To: District Office
From: May Chen, Owner of Chen Books

I have two employees available for the clean-up event, and I can join after opening the store at 9 A.M. If we arrive after the planting team leaves, can we still help with sidewalk litter or sign reports? We would still like Chen Books to be included on the website if our three volunteers are accepted.
